thread:
Hannah Brooks: ChargeBot flagged a weird spike on the dedicated-gpu-pool billing account — ~$38k on 2026-06-14 billed to customer-managed-dedicated. can infra confirm whether this was customer traffic or internal overflow? :eyes:
ChargeBot: Alert: Dedicated pool overrun detected. Billing delta: $37,842. Top SKUs: a100-80gb (reserved fallback), vram-attachment fees. Export: https://console.billing/exports/dedicated-2026-06-14.csv
Vikram Patel: checking allocation 1: looks like the autoscaler fell back to the dedicated pool when hosted capacity hit the tenant limit. fallback rule is "dedicated:allow=true" so those fallback jobs inherit the pool billing. some of the jobs were internal stress tests that should've used the dev-dedicated account.
Marta Ruiz: that explains it. I ran the job owner map and 28 runs show owner_tag=internal-loadtest but billing tags were customer:acme-corp. tagging mismatch during fallback.
Hannah Brooks: finance needs line-item IDs + a short narrative to request a vendor reallocation. can infra export a CSV with lineItemId, job_id, owner_tag, billing_account?
Vikram Patel: done. Minimal query used on billing export to filter fallback events. I'll drop csv as dedicated-fallback-20260614.csv to /shared/finance-temp and include run_owner and whether fallback_policy=true.
ChargeBot: Note: billing snapshot 2026-07-02T01:05:12Z. Recommendation: open vendor support case with lineItemIds and request reallocation to dev-dedicated for internal load tests.
Paul Green: finance: provisional approval for a charge transfer to dev-dedicated pending infra CSV + manager sign-off. final approval after vendor response.
Marta Ruiz: uploaded CSV: https://files.internal/shared/finance-temp/dedicated-fallback-20260614.csv. Included columns: lineItemId, usageStart, usageEnd, instanceId, owner_tag, fallback_policy.
Hannah Brooks: thanks. i'll draft the vendor case: "internal load tests misattributed due to fallback policy into customer-managed dedicated pool; request reallocation." will cc legal.
Vikram Patel: short-term mitigation: i've updated the autoscaler policy to prefer hosted-capacity and added a hard deny for internal-loadtest owner_tag to route to dev-dedicated. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/autoscaler/pull/922
Paul Green: also request an alert: when dedicated-pool daily cost increases by > $10k vs 7-day baseline, notify #billing-alerts + eng-infra. finance signs off on that threshold.
Hannah Brooks: approved. can we also add a weekly reconciliation report that checks for owner_tag != billing_account mapping and auto-notify owners when mismatches > $500? want to catch this earlier.
Marta Ruiz: setting up the weekly audit job and will post results to #billing-weekly. i'll include a separate CSV for any mismatches.
Vikram Patel: PR merged, audit job scheduled. i'll post the vendor case number here when i submit.
Hannah Brooks: thanks team, appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
